title: Australia’s NAB to test AI agent safeguards – report
excerpt: According to a AFR report, thousands of Westpac bankers are using bots to review mortgage and credit card applications.
content_html:
Vidhya Edwards Munnangi

Wed, August 5, 2026 at 7:47 AM EDT 2 min read

National Australia Bank (NAB) is preparing to test the security and operational controls of an agentic AI platform, as major Australian lenders work towards broader use of the technology, reported Bloomberg.

The bank's plan to allow AI agents to deal with staff and internal systems on behalf of customers is raising questions about the limits of those tools and the tasks they should be allowed to perform, said Patrick Wright, group executive for technology and enterprise operations.

In an interview, Wright said: "Customers will expect one day to interact with us through agents," adding that the bank is looking to do pilots and experiments over the next year.

This is the first time NAB has publicly set out this approach.

The Melbourne-based bank is applying agentic AI to some internal work, including support for its operations team on more complicated tasks, Wright said.

The planned testing is intended to address the risk of unexpected mistakes. Wright said "security is the thing I think about," and "we've got to do it in a way that's safe,".

Commonwealth Bank of Australia (CBA) also partnered with OpenAI last year to explore cutting edge generative AI-enabled banking services.

A separate Australian Financial Review report said that thousands of Westpac bankers are using bots to review mortgage and credit card applications, as the lender seeks to show returns from increased AI spending and reduce the distance with Commonwealth Bank.

Westpac said the AI agents saved 12,500 banker hours in the first month of operation in July, annualised at 150,000 hours.

At an event hosted by Amazon Web Services in Sydney, McMullan said Westpac's mortgage and consumer lending bankers were using a multi-agent system, built using AWS's Bedrock AgentCore system, as the US cloud group expanded its role in financial services.

The agents are handling more than 1.5 million transactions and more than 32,000 payslips each week.

The bank is planning a wider rollout of agents.

It has reportedly already reduced the time needed to build a new agent from six months last year to six weeks and was targeting a real-time system that would allow staff to deploy agents for different tasks.

"For our people, verifying income can be really complex, time-consuming and full of policy judgment. So our specialist agents work together around the banker," said McMullan.

"Australia's NAB to test AI agent safeguards – report" was originally created and published by Retail Banker International, a GlobalData owned brand.

维迪亚·爱德华兹·穆南吉

2026 年 8 月 5 日星期三，美国东部时间上午 7:47 阅读 2 分钟

据彭博社报道，澳大利亚国民银行 (NAB) 正准备测试代理人工智能平台的安全性和操作控制，澳大利亚主要银行正致力于更广泛地使用该技术。

技术和企业运营集团主管帕特里克·赖特 (Patrick Wright) 表示，该银行计划允许人工智能代理代表客户与员工和内部系统打交道，这引发了人们对这些工具的局限性以及应允许它们执行的任务的质疑。

赖特在接受采访时表示：“客户希望有一天能够通过代理与我们互动”，并补充说该银行希望在明年进行试点和实验。

这是NAB首次公开提出这一做法。

赖特说，这家总部位于墨尔本的银行正在将代理人工智能应用于一些内部工作，包括支持其运营团队执行更复杂的任务。

计划的测试旨在解决意外错误的风险。 赖特说，“安全是我考虑的事情”，“我们必须以安全的方式来做这件事”。

澳大利亚联邦银行 (CBA) 去年也与 OpenAI 合作，探索尖端的生成式人工智能银行服务。

另一份《澳大利亚金融评论》报告称，数千名西太平洋银行家正在使用机器人来审查抵押贷款和信用卡申请，因为该银行试图展示人工智能支出增加带来的回报，并缩短与联邦银行的距离。

Westpac 表示，人工智能代理在 7 月份运营的第一个月就为银行工作人员节省了 12,500 个工作时间，年化节省了 150,000 个工作时间。

在亚马逊网络服务在悉尼举办的一次活动中，麦克马兰表示，随着美国云集团扩大其在金融服务中的作用，西太平洋银行的抵押贷款和消费贷款银行家正在使用使用 AWS 的 Bedrock AgentCore 系统构建的多代理系统。

代理商每周处理超过 150 万笔交易和超过 32,000 张工资单。

该银行正计划扩大代理范围。

据报道，该公司已经将构建新代理所需的时间从去年的六个月减少到六周，并瞄准了一个实时系统，允许工作人员为不同的任务部署代理。

“对于我们的人民来说，核实收入可能非常复杂、耗时且充满政策判断。 因此，我们的专业代理人围绕银行家一起工作，”麦克穆兰说。

《澳大利亚国民银行测试人工智能代理保障措施报告》最初由 GlobalData 旗下品牌 Retail Banker International 创建和发布。
